summary: Frontend E2E of Emergent Object Storage image uploads (profile photos + admin product images) plus 3 light backend regression curls. All flows PASS. Admin flow: /admin-secure-login succeeded with rotated creds -> /admin/products -> Add Product dialog -> uploaded 1x1 PNG via data-testid=pf-image-upload. 'Uploading…' (pf-image-uploading) rendered, then pf-image-preview src became https://.../api/files/anjali-herbal-life/products//.png. Saved product (TEST-UPL-*), then verified the same URL renders as an on the public /products page. Cleaned up with DELETE /api/admin/products/{id}/permanent -> 200. Distributor flow: Used admin POST /api/admin/users/{ANJ000215_id}/reset-password to set Test@1234, logged in at /login, navigated to /app/profile, uploaded PNG via data-testid=profile-photo-input. Avatar src became https://.../api/files/anjali-herbal-life/profile//.jpg (not data:). Remove photo via data-testid=remove-photo-link -> initials fallback restored and 'Photo removed' toast visible. Backend curls: POST /api/uploads/profile-photo (no auth) -> 401; POST /api/admin/uploads/product-image with text/plain file (admin auth) -> 400 'Only JPG, PNG or WebP images are allowed.'; GET /api/files/anjali-herbal-life/products/nonexistent/abc.jpg -> 404 'File not found'. All as expected.

issues: Minor React console warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' on an . Likely one of the avatar-adjacent components (IdCard QR or similar) renders when user.photo is cleared. Harmless but should pass null/undefined instead.

action_items: Optional (low priority): Avoid rendering when distributor has no photo — pass null or conditionally render to silence React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py:57-59 — _public_url derives scheme by whether host starts with 'localhost'/'127.0.0.1'. Works behind Kubernetes ingress but will yield wrong scheme if x-forwarded-proto differs from the heuristic. Prefer request.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto') with https fallback.

storage.py init_storage caches _storage_key as module-level global; concurrent first-request storms could call /init multiple times. Low impact (idempotent on backend) but a lock/single-flight would be cleaner.
Profile.js resizeImage always re-encodes as image/jpeg at quality 0.85 — PNG/WebP transparency is lost. Acceptable for avatars but note the output extension stays .jpg regardless of input.
